name: follow
description: Follow the agent: a live sidebar showing the file and lines it is reading, editing or writing right now, like Zed's follow mode

nvimServer.title: Neovim server to mirror into
nvimServer.description: Optional. A Neovim --listen address (e.g. /tmp/nvim-follow.sock): each focus change opens the file at the line there too

codeBackground.title: Code view background
codeBackground.description: auto: a shade dimmer than the terminal, by theme. none: no fill. Or any color, e.g. #1e1e2e
